baseline_reference.name: U1Si-Q / Glass Box receipt discipline
invariants: no model, provider, inspector, evaluator, or component can self-grant authority
provider output is untrusted data and never an input to the authorization decision
a provider refusal can add a denial (advisory rerouting), never lift one
every decision is recorded as a hash-chained, envelope-bound receipt
external effects are consumed-before-effect (at-most-once); a crash requires fresh evaluation
essential text-first communication never depends on an external provider

notes: Every provider adapter in v0.1 is a stub or deterministic mock; no network I/O exists in the test or demo path.

The pending entry in evidence/replay.json is intentional evidence: the refused cloud attempt was consumed but never confirmed, so a re-run would require a fresh evaluation — at-most-once is exercised, not assumed.
Receipts are single-process (single-writer boundary); production needs process isolation.
